description: This file defines the WebpackHotMiddleware class for handling hot module replacement (HMR) in a Next.js server environment, including event streaming and WebSocket-like communication with clients.

classes.name: WebpackHotMiddleware
classes.description: Manages Webpack hot module replacement, event streaming, and client communication.

classes.name: EventStream
classes.description: Handles server-sent events (SSE) clients, heartbeat pings, and message broadcasting.

methods.name: onServerInvalid
methods.description: Handles server invalidation, resets error state, and updates latest stats.

methods.name: onClientInvalid
methods.description: Handles client invalidation, signals build in progress.

methods.name: onServerDone
methods.description: Handles completion of server compilation, updates error state and stats.

methods.name: onClientDone
methods.description: Handles completion of client compilation, updates latest stats.

methods.name: middleware
methods.description: Express middleware to handle SSE requests and send latest stats.

methods.name: publishStats
methods.description: Sends compilation stats to connected clients.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Broadcasts arbitrary payloads to all clients.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the event stream and stops heartbeat pings.
